forbidden.reason: “Milch” is reserved for animal milk under EU law (Reg. 1308/2013, CJEU C-422/16 “TofuTown”).
Plant drinks must not be called milk (Reg. 1308/2013).
General health claims need an authorised specific claim (Health Claims Reg. 1924/2006, Art. 10).
forbidden.suggestion: Describe ingredients factually, e.g. “mit Ballaststoffen aus Hafer”.

forbidden.reason: Courts require the basis to be explained in the ad itself (BGH, I ZR 98/23, 2024). Not used by the brand.
forbidden.suggestion: Name the concrete measure, e.g. “Hafer aus Bayern, 120 km bis zur Abfüllung”.

forbidden.reason: Absolute naturalness claims are hard to prove.
forbidden.suggestion: ohne Zusatz von Zucker / mit 4 Zutaten

forbidden.reason: Only allowed at ≤ 0.5 g sugar per 100 ml (Reg. 1924/2006 annex). Check the product.
